title: A Deadline for the Asset
author: Gideon Voss
blurb: Ada Sterling, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
